n: 18 Cu. Ft. Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator
desc: Keep your food fresh and organized with this ENERGY STAR® certified refrigerator. Designed with CrispSeal Crispers to keep produce fresher longer, it also features edge-to-edge glass shelves, gallon door bins, and a 3-tier freezer for maximum storage in a compact footprint.
hl: Keep produce fresher longer, so you waste less and save money.
Enhanced storage in a compact design
Find a place for all your favorites with our gallon door bin storage, edge to edge glass shelves and a 3 tier freezer storage.
Prevent warm spots and unwanted freezing with our cooling system that optimizes airflow to ensure a consistent temperature throughout your refrigerator.
Save money and maximize energy efficiency.
Ensures your doors are never left slightly open by automatically closing once the door is ajar 5” or less.
